judge.rationale: The candidate stopped after writing a `.lore/dod.md` planning file, a partial edit to `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, and a single failing acceptance test file (`src/transport/ws/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`). It did not implement any of the production code required by the issue: `src/types/messages.ts`, `src/types/session.ts` (`ErrorCodes`), `src/transport/ws/validation.ts`, `src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts`, `src/transport/createServer.ts`, and `src/config.ts` are all untouched. Noticeably, the test file itself has to cast `{history: {enabled: true}} as unknown as Partial<HalServerOptions>` because the option was never added to `HalServerOptions`. Consequently, the candidate's own tests fail and almost none of the ticket's acceptance criteria (implementation, error handling, `StoreCannotList`, docs regeneration, and changelog) are met.
